feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: How long does it take to save up for a starter home? Twice as long as it did in 2019
entry.summary: A new analysis finds that the average renter household now needs 16 years to save for a down payment and closing costs. Rising rents and other costs have consumed a growing share of household budgets.

entry.title: Trump merchandise stores are closing: 'He has peaked'
entry.summary: At least four Trump merchandise stores have closed this year. Store owners say with Trump in his final term, there isn't as much to fire up his consumer fan base and sales have softened.

entry.title: How prize-winning pumpkin growers produce the biggest gourds
entry.summary: Morning Edition speaks to champion pumpkin growers about what it takes to be the best in their field.

entry.title: A look at Elon Musk's wide-reaching influence
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with tech journalist Kara Swisher about Elon Musk's influence on business, politics and global affairs.

entry.title: Supreme Court upholds pause on Trump's anti-trans prison policy
entry.summary: The Supreme Court ruled Wednesday that the Trump administration has to continue providing gender-affirming care to inmates in federal prisons as litigation on efforts to change the policy continues.

entry.title: Sentenced to death at 17, at 68, quilt artist receives solo museum exhibition
entry.summary: A quilt artist who spent decades on death row now has his first solo exhibit at the Grand Rapids Art Museum.

entry.title: Mississippi AG says use of force was 'justified' in fatal shooting of toddler
entry.summary: Mississippi's Attorney General says the use of force was justified when a toddler was killed during a police shooting after a shoplifting.

entry.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request
entry.summary: The announcement of Hubbard's release came as talks got underway between Putin and White House envoy Steve Witkoff in Saint Petersburg focused on the latest U.S. efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

entry.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
entry.summary: Arrests for more minor offenses, including vagrancy, rose in the U.S., even as violent crime rates dropped to historic lows, according to an analysis from criminal justice reform advocacy group FWD.us

entry.title: FAA clears the way for airlines to put Boeing's long-delayed 737 Max 10 into service
entry.summary: Nearly a decade after Boeing unveiled its largest 737 Max jet, the company has cleared a major hurdle in its effort to bring the plane to airlines.
